## Verification

- [ ] New dependencies are license-compatible and recorded for notices/SBOM work.
- [ ] Every commit includes a Developer Certificate of Origin `Signed-off-by` line.
- [ ] New original source files include the required copyright and Apache-2.0 SPDX header.
